issues.sentence: With 40 teleoperated demonstrations per task the policy reached 78% success on cup stacking and 61% on towel folding, outperforming a behavior-cloning baseline by 34 and 32 percentage points respectively [lib:cv].
issues.problem: The specific margins of 34 and 32 percentage points over a behavior-cloning baseline are not present in any library source; lib:cv only states the diffusion policy outperformed a behaviour-cloning baseline on towel folding without giving numeric margins.
